newsitem.title: KUWAIT: U.S. troops in Kuwait, desert deployment delayed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. troops in Kuwait, desert deployment delayed.

text.p: All 3,000 U.S. ground forces sent to the Gulf to deter possible Iraqi threats have arrived in Kuwait but a desert storm has delayed their full deployment close to the border, U.S. officers said on Monday.
The last batch of the some 3,000 1st Cavalry soldiers arrived in Kuwait on a commercial aircraft from Texas on Sunday and were still at Camp Doha, north Kuwait, on Monday.
The sky over Kuwait City was darkened on Sunday by a thick cloud of sand and dust stirred by an overnight desert storm which delayed the deployment of the arriving soldiers.
"The full deployment will certainly be completed this week...maybe as early as Tuesday," said one officer.

The soldiers, who started the airlift from Texas on Wednesday, join another 1,200 U.S. troops stationed in Kuwait before the latest crisis with Iraq erupted on August 31 when Baghdad's forces sided with one group in factional Kurdish fighting in northern Iraq.
Washington responded by firing 44 cruise missiles on September 3 and 4 at targets in southern Iraq.
